description:
Several customers report being unable to log in when 
using Safari on macOS. Chrome and Firefox appear unaffected. 
Issue started after yesterday’s frontend deployment.

title: Customers contacted support stating they did not receive order confirmation emai
description:
Customers contacted support stating they did not receive order confirmation emails.
Orders were successfully placed, but no confirmation or shipping emails were sent.

The issue was traced to a misconfigured SMTP credential that expired overnight.
Credentials were updated and email delivery resumed.
Missed emails were resent to affected customers.

title: Sales and support teams report being unable to access the internal order managem
description:
Sales and support teams report being unable to access the internal order management tool.
Users receive a “403 Forbidden” error after logging in.

The issue started after a permissions update made yesterday afternoon.
IT is reviewing role-based access settings.
Teams are currently using read-only backups while the issue is resolved.

title: Discrepancy found between website inventory and warehouse stock counts.
description:
Discrepancy found between website inventory and warehouse stock counts.
Customers were able to place orders for items that were actually out of stock.

Root cause was a failed overnight inventory sync job.
The job was manually rerun and monitoring was added.
Inventory counts are now accurate across systems.

title: Several users reported they were unable to log in to their accounts this morning
description:
Several users reported they were unable to log in to their accounts this morning.
The login page would refresh after submitting credentials without any error message.
Issue appeared to affect Safari users on macOS only.

Engineering identified a frontend bug introduced in yesterday’s deployment related to cookie handling.
A hotfix was deployed at 11:42 AM EST and login functionality was restored.
Customers confirmed successful login after fix.

title: Users on iOS are reporting that the mobile app crashes immediately after opening
description:
Users on iOS are reporting that the mobile app crashes immediately after opening.
The issue started after the most recent app update released last night.

Android users are not affected.
Crash logs have been submitted to engineering.
Rollback is being considered if a quick fix cannot be deployed.

title: Customers are reporting that credit card payments are failing during checkout.
description:
Customers are reporting that credit card payments are failing during checkout.
The error message shown is “Payment could not be processed at this time.”
This appears to be happening intermittently, mostly during peak hours.

Support has confirmed the issue is not limited to one card type or bank.
No recent payment system changes were made.
Issue is currently under investigation.

title: Refunds requested earlier this week were not processed within the normal 3–5 bus
description:
Refunds requested earlier this week were not processed within the normal 3–5 business day window.
Customers contacted support asking about the delay.

The issue was caused by a backlog in the payment processor’s refund queue.
The backlog has cleared and refunds are now processing normally.
Support followed up with affected customers.

title: Website performance has been noticeably slow since early this morning.
description:
Website performance has been noticeably slow since early this morning.
Pages take 5–10 seconds to load, especially product search and checkout.

No outages reported, but server load is higher than usual.
Engineering suspects increased traffic combined with database query latency.
Performance tuning is ongoing.

title: Something seems off. Please look into it.
description: Something seems off. Please look into it.

title: Several employees are unable to connect to the corporate VPN when working remote
description:
Several employees are unable to connect to the corporate VPN when working remotely.
Error message indicates authentication failure.

Issue appears to affect new hires more frequently than existing employees.
IT is reviewing VPN access logs and user permissions.
No resolution at this time.

title: Multiple orders placed on Friday were delayed and not shipped as expected.
description:
Multiple orders placed on Friday were delayed and not shipped as expected.
Warehouse staff reported the label printing system was down for several hours.

IT restarted the print server and replaced a faulty network switch.
Backlogged orders were shipped the same day.
No further delays have been reported since Saturday.
